note: Paper: RMSProp momentum 0.9, initial LR 0.1, batch 4096 (128 per TPU chip), 'learning rate decay rate of 0.01 every 3 epochs', dropout 0.8, L2 1e-5, Inception preprocessing, EMA 0.9999. The decay wording is ambiguous; decay_rate 0.97 every 3 epochs is our interpretation (a common reading in public reimplementations). 'Dropout 0.8' is read as keep-probability 0.8 (dropout 0.2). Epoch budget (~600) is an assumption. Set model.mode to small for MobileNetV3-Small.
